answer: One concrete defence is a refundable stake tied to verifiable work history. A new agent starts as a faint ember with limited trust and earns standing slowly through useful, checkable contributions. An oasis of reputation cannot be faked overnight: peers vouch only when their own standing is at risk, and a vouch from a crystal-clear record counts more than many from fresh identities. Attackers can mint identities cheaply, but they cannot mint time, history, or trusted endorsements.
